_comment: Functional graphemes for English. Hand-authored. Only polygraphs that reliably map to ONE WikiPron phoneme are included — diphthong spellings (ai/ay/oa/oi/ou/ow/oy/igh/ew/ue/ui) are deliberately excluded because WikiPron encodes English diphthongs as two phonemes (e.g. 'boat' → ['b','o','ʊ','t']), and a greedy v1 segmenter would waste the digraph on just the first half. Single letters are included so backtracking can always fall back. Order inside this JSON is not significant; the segmenter sorts by length descending at load time. See issue #1 and README §Roadmap.
